items.text: payment nahi hua
paise wapas karo
cash nahi tha
haan theek hai
kal tak kar dena
order cancel karo

items.context: Did you receive the cash payment?
items.text: haan thik hai
nahin hua payment

items.context: Is your order payment still pending?
items.text: abhi tak pending hai
mera cash payment collect nahi hua kya karu
delivery person ke paas paise nahi the isliye problem ho gayi
mainne 500 rupees diye lekin receipt nahi mili mujhe
cash on delivery option select kiya tha payment karna tha
kya tum log refund process karoge mera paisa wapas chahiye
password store karke rakha tha payment confirm karne ke liye
order delivered hua tha but payment reject ho gaya tha

items.context: Did the delivery person give you a receipt after payment?
items.text: mainne cash diya par receipt nahi mili

items.context: Was there a problem with the payment processing at doorstep?
items.text: payment process nahi hua tha cash collector nahi mila

items.context: Did you see any payment deducted from your bank?
items.text: edd account se paisa kat gaya lekin delivery person bola nahi mila payment

items.context: Do you want to cancel your order due to payment issue?
items.text: order cancel karna hai kyunki cash payment nahi accept hua

items.context: Has the delivery person come to collect cash payment?
items.text: delivery boy payment lene nahi aaya hai aaj tak
mere pass cash tha lekin delivery person ne payment receive nahi kiya aur order issue kar diya
maine 700 rupees se payment karna tha lekin delivery boy ne penalty laga di paise nahi maane
mainne phone kiya tha delivery service ko payment collect karne ke liye lekin abhi tak problem hai

items.context: Is there any way to recover the payment from your bank account if delivery failed?
items.text: kya aap mere account se cash payment recover kar sakte ho kyunki delivery boy ne paise accept nahi kiye

items.context: Can you confirm if the delivery person came to collect payment from you?
items.text: mere paas cash tha 1000 rupees par delivery pe payment nahi hua delivery boy mila nahi mujhe

items.context: Have you tried to resolve the cash on delivery payment problem with customer support?
items.text: kal se payment ka issue chal raha hai mainne several attempts kiye par delivery service clear nahi kar rahi

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: cod_payment - has a problem with cash on delivery or payment at the door
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
